sources.title: WhiskyAKM/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Overview Qwen3.8-27B is a native vision-language (image-text-to-text) causal language model with a separate vision encoder, built on the Qwen3.5 architectural foundation. Its defining trait is a hybrid stack: three Gated DeltaNet (linear/recurrent attention) layers for every one Gated Attention (full softmax attention) layer, each followed by a standard dense SwiGLU FFN.
